create_HumEnv: create a HumEnv humanoid simulation environment with a reward task, XML model, and state init mode
reset_HumEnv: reset the HumEnv environment to a t-pose, fall, or MoCap-based initial state
step_HumEnv: step the HumEnv environment forward with an action and return observation, reward, and termination
render_HumEnv: render the HumEnv simulation as an RGB array from the configured camera angle
compute_humanoid_self_obs_v2: compute a proprioceptive observation dictionary with heading-invariant local body positions, rotations, and velocities
